about: Polansky & Cichon, Chtd. is a personal injury firm with a single office in Chicago.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Illinois does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Illinois does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Illinois publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 5 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 101 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2014-11-14, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

score.verdict: 2 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
